body:
## Why

Treadmill interval templates were hardcoded frontend constants (`frontend/src/utils/cardioTemplates.js`), so adding or editing a variant meant a code change + redeploy. Templates are data — they should live in the DB like the exercise library.

## What

Promotes treadmill templates to a first-class **`cardio-template`** Cosmos document type (`userId: 'shared'`, the same shared-library model used by `exercise` and `workout-day-definition`).

- **New default template** `Walk/Jog 5×6.0 + 1×7.0` — jogs `6.0 → 6.0 → 6.0 → 6.0 → 6.0 → 7.0`, 2-min walks between, 38 min total. The old `5×5.4 + 1×6.0` remains available as the second option.
- **backend** (`routes/routes/cardio.js`): public `GET /api/cardio-templates` + admin `POST/PUT/DELETE /api/cardio-templates`.
- **seed** (`routes/data/seed-cardio-templates.js`): source of truth; `init-database` deletes-then-upserts templates (idempotent), mirroring exercise seeding.
- **snapshot** (`generate-snapshot.js`): new `cardio_templates` table so anonymous visitors get templates from the SQLite snapshot.
- **frontend**: `WorkoutDrawer` loads templates via `useDataSource().fetchCardioTemplates()` (live API when signed in, snapshot otherwise). `cardioTemplates.js` is retained **only** as an offline fallback that mirrors the seed, so the dropdown is never blank if the source is empty or errors (same role `dayConfig.js` plays for day definitions).

Logged `cardio-session` docs are unaffected — they already store their own full interval array, so editing/removing a template never rewrites history.

## Activation
After merge + deploy, run admin **Initialize Database** (`POST /api/admin/init-database`) once to seed the two template docs; the snapshot cron picks them up on its next run. Until then, all read paths fall back to the static mirror gracefully.

## Verification
- `npm run build` ✓, `npm run lint` ✓ (0 errors; only pre-existing exhaustive-deps warnings)
- Backend/snapshot `node --check` ✓
- Ran the anonymous read path end-to-end (seed → SQLite → `getCardioTemplates`): default is `walk-jog-5x-60`, jog speeds `[6,6,6,6,6,7]`, 38 min total.
title: feat: move treadmill templates to a cardio-template DB type
